newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn to set tender for 2-yr notes on March 17.
newsitem.headline: Bonn to set tender for 2-yr notes on March 17.

text.p: The German government will set a tender for two-year Treasury notes on March 17, with bids due by 1000 GMT on March 18, the Bundesbank said in a statement on Monday.
The government is aiming for an issue volume of 12 billion marks rather than the volume of up to 10 billion marks stated in the government's issue calendar for the first quarter, the Bundesbank said.
The notes mature on March 19, 1999. The settlement date is March 20 and the notes will be listed on securities exchanges on March 21.
The government brought the issue forward by one day. It was originally scheduled for March 19.
